note: fix-v2 gen bake: castle pictures with towers, gatehouses and a 2-deep camp, art metadata on every level, closest margin, no one-card spam, difficulty step-up; rule A. Level format: SPEC-v2 §8. Numbers: tools/fix-v2-gen-report.md and tools/m0c-report.md.

levels.name: One Wall
levels.teaches: Tap the mason card. He walks from the camp to the nearest stone wall and breaks it. Open wall to the keep wins.

levels.name: Outside In
levels.teaches: The mason has no wall he can reach yet, so his card waits. Send the axemen through the timber first.

levels.name: Closest First
levels.teaches: A crew always walks to the nearest wall of its kind. Right now the nearest stone is the back wall. Open the gate first and the keep's wall becomes nearest.

levels.name: Goats & a Chest
levels.teaches: Goats eat hedge. Open the garden and the chest inside hands you a mason for the keep.

levels.name: The Frozen Moat
levels.teaches: Nobody crosses the moat. Torchbearers melt the ice bridge, then the axemen and the mason have a way in.

levels.name: Iron and a Lever
levels.teaches: No crew can break iron. Open the lever house and the lever swings the iron door open for you.
